audit.checkpoint: transfer/<condition>/checkpoint at the final predefined workflow budget, never best TEST or dev checkpoint
audit.coverage: Every condition recorded in completed source result.transfer. Missing stopped stream arms reported explicitly. Four primitive TEST sets, workflow TEST and novel workflow TEST per condition.
audit.comparison: Full generated records exactly, with token, format, execution, semantic-result and aggregate-score agreement separately reported.
audit.process: Standalone entrypoint loads a fresh base from the hash-pinned snapshot. It restores each complete adapter state using the existing loader. No optimizer construction or updates.

compression.checkpoint: fusion/<method>/checkpoint before workflow training; no checkpoint search
compression.eligibility: Original primitive_gate for every family using original baseline validation and saved fused validation. Repeat fused validation after fresh-process reload; require exact saved-record agreement before SVD.
compression.failed_gate: Record branch_gate_failed and skip SVD, TEST evaluation and any teacher designation for that branch. Continue the other prespecified method.
compression.matrix: D = offset + (alpha/rank) * B @ A, assembled from stored FP32 tensors in CPU float64.
compression.svd: torch.linalg.svd(D, full_matrices=False) on CPU float64: complete reduced spectrum, no randomized or approximate SVD, no gradient updates.
compression.factors: A = Vh[:8]; B = U[:,:8] * S[:8] / scaling. Store contiguous FP32 A/B and offset=None, with original rank/alpha/target modules.
compression.precision_boundary: Exact means non-randomized dense SVD in floating point; stored FP32 factor reconstruction error is measured separately from ideal singular-value tail energy.
compression.scoring: Preserve original native generation/EOS/parser/execution contract and original evaluation batch size/order. Measure all four primitive dev/TEST sets and target workflow dev/TEST/novel-TEST for original and compressed states.
compression.test_firewall: Gate and commit fixed rank8 checkpoint before reading any saved TEST prediction records or generating TEST answers. No TEST-dependent rank, checkpoint, compression or teacher selection.
compression.memory: Report factor/offset tensor bytes, checkpoint-file bytes and preserved expert archive separately. Base weights are unchanged; source expert training updates/exposures remain counted. SVD workspace is not measured as resident inference memory.
compression.teacher: No teacher, bank distillation or PorTAL bridge is started or qualified by this experiment.

primary_source.local_inspection: torch.linalg.svd docstring and CPU float64 reduced-SVD REPL; CPU 2.14.0 inspection, GPU runtime remains parent-qualified vendor ROCm torch.
